findings.title: Data-source disclosure omits the earnings-release accession and the price source
findings.detail: The Disclosures section cites only the trigger 10-Q accession 0000002488-26-000191 and the price date. Quotes Q-1 to Q-4 (guidance and demand commentary) come from release_ex99_1.txt, which is from accession 0000002488-26-000188 (snapshot/manifest.json), and the share price comes from the Yahoo chart endpoint (snapshot/prices.json note). Policy section 6 is met because the trigger accession, cutoff and price date are all present. Naming the release accession and the price provider would make the as-of trail complete.
findings.required_evidence: Disclosures line also names accession 0000002488-26-000188 for the release quotes and the provider of the closing price

findings.title: 'All figures ... from SEC XBRL data' overstates the provenance of guidance and price figures
findings.detail: The final disclosure says all figures are generated by code from SEC XBRL data. The Results section heading also tags the earnings release as '(SEC XBRL data)'. The guidance values (guide_revenue_next_q $17.0bn, guide_non_gaap_gross_margin_next_q 55.0%) come from release text quotes Q-1 and Q-2 (values.json sources), not XBRL. Price and peer market data come from the price host. The policy statement itself is present. The wording should limit the XBRL claim to reported financials, or note that guidance comes from quoted release text and prices from the price feed.
findings.required_evidence: Disclosure distinguishes XBRL-derived reported figures from release-quoted guidance and price-feed data
